base.description: Base currency ISO 4217 (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Default: USD.

convert.description: Optional point-in-time conversion. E.g. {amount: 1000, from: 'USD', to: 'EUR'} at the requested date.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2023-03-15'). Use 'latest' for today's ECB rate. Historical data available from 1999-01-04.

end_date.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD for a time-series range. Max recommended range: 365 days. Returns rates keyed by date.

symbols.description: Specific currencies to return (e.g. ['EUR','GBP','JPY']). Omit for all 30 supported currencies.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Historical ECB exchange rates — single date lookup or time-series range. Returns rates for up to 30 major currencies (EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, CHF, CNY, AUD, KRW, etc.) from 1999-01-04 to present. Free, no key, sourced from Frankfurter/ECB. Use for: tax-date FX rates, historical expense reconciliation, multi-year trend analysis, point-in-time currency conversion. Weekends and holidays return the nearest prior business day. Complements forex-rates (real-time) with retrospective data.
